constraints.name: bpay_next_net_replacement_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((prior_projection_no = 0) = (prior_projection_id IS NULL)) AND ((prior_state_id IS NULL) = (prior_projection_id IS NULL))))

constraints.name: bpay_next_net_replacement_check10
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((inventory_age_key IS NULL) AND (inventory_case_id IS NULL) AND (inventory_component_ordinal IS NULL) AND (inventory_component_id IS NULL)) OR ((inventory_age_key IS NOT NULL) AND (inventory_case_id IS NOT NULL) AND (inventory_component_ordinal IS NOT NULL) AND (inventory_component_id IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: bpay_next_net_replacement_check11
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((metadata_pay_date_cursor IS NULL) AND (metadata_created_at_cursor IS NULL) AND (metadata_run_cursor IS NULL)) OR ((metadata_pay_date_cursor IS NOT NULL) AND (metadata_created_at_cursor IS NOT NULL) AND (metadata_run_cursor IS NOT NULL) AND isfinite(metadata_pay_date_cursor) AND isfinite(metadata_created_at_cursor))))

constraints.name: bpay_next_net_replacement_check12
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((validation_pay_date_cursor IS NULL) AND (validation_created_at_cursor IS NULL) AND (validation_run_cursor IS NULL)) OR ((validation_pay_date_cursor IS NOT NULL) AND (validation_created_at_cursor IS NOT NULL) AND (validation_run_cursor IS NOT NULL) AND isfinite(validation_pay_date_cursor) AND isfinite(validation_created_at_cursor))))

constraints.name: bpay_next_net_replacement_check14
constraints.definition: CHECK (((stage <> 'COMPLETE'::text) OR ((accepted_projection_id IS NOT NULL) AND (cash_amount IS NOT NULL) AND (committed_instruction_count = expected_instruction_count) AND (staging_step = 'DONE'::text))))

constraints.name: bpay_next_net_replacement_check15
constraints.definition: CHECK (((stage <> 'CANCELLED'::text) OR ((cleanup_step = 'DONE'::text) AND (inventory_instruction_count = expected_instruction_count) AND (cleanup_instruction_count = expected_instruction_count) AND (released_hold_count = expected_releasable_hold_count) AND ((released_source_total)::numeric = (expected_releasable_source_total)::numeric))))

constraints.name: bpay_next_net_replacement_check16
constraints.definition: CHECK (((stage <> ALL (ARRAY['CANCEL_REQUESTED'::text, 'CANCELLING'::text, 'CANCELLED'::text])) OR (cancel_command_id IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: bpay_next_net_replacement_check17
constraints.definition: CHECK (((updated_at_utc >= created_at_utc) AND ((finished_at_utc IS NULL) OR (finished_at_utc >= created_at_utc))))

constraints.name: bpay_next_net_replacement_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK (((staged_instruction_count <= expected_instruction_count) AND (validated_instruction_count <= staged_instruction_count) AND (committed_instruction_count <= validated_instruction_count) AND (cleanup_instruction_count <= expected_instruction_count) AND (inventory_instruction_count <= expected_instruction_count) AND (released_hold_count <= expected_releasable_hold_count) AND ((released_source_total)::numeric <= (expected_releasable_source_total)::numeric)))

constraints.name: bpay_next_net_replacement_check4
constraints.definition: CHECK (((staged_deduction_count <= staged_instruction_count) AND (committed_deduction_count <= staged_deduction_count) AND (staged_old_hold_count <= staged_deduction_count) AND (proposed_hold_count <= staged_deduction_count) AND (committed_old_hold_count <= staged_old_hold_count) AND ((committed_old_source_total)::numeric <= (staged_old_source_total)::numeric) AND (committed_new_hold_count <= proposed_hold_count) AND ((committed_new_source_total)::numeric <= (proposed_source_total)::numeric)))

constraints.name: bpay_next_net_replacement_check5
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((cursor_age_key IS NULL) AND (cursor_case_id IS NULL) AND (cursor_component_ordinal IS NULL) AND (cursor_component_id IS NULL)) OR ((cursor_age_key IS NOT NULL) AND (cursor_case_id IS NOT NULL) AND (cursor_component_ordinal IS NOT NULL) AND (cursor_component_id IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: bpay_next_net_replacement_check6
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((cleanup_age_key IS NULL) AND (cleanup_case_id IS NULL) AND (cleanup_component_ordinal IS NULL) AND (cleanup_component_id IS NULL)) OR ((cleanup_age_key IS NOT NULL) AND (cleanup_case_id IS NOT NULL) AND (cleanup_component_ordinal IS NOT NULL) AND (cleanup_component_id IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: bpay_next_net_replacement_check9
constraints.definition: CHECK (((stage = ANY (ARRAY['PRECHECK'::text, 'REFUSED'::text])) OR (original_job_id IS NOT NULL)))
